items.title: Sushi & sashimi
items.text: Hamachi sashimi, sake zuke don, nigiri and negi hama maki prepared fresh at the event.

details.intro: Fresh fish, sashimi and sushi prepared directly during Japan Day.

items.title: Japanese dishes & grill
items.text: Roasted hamachi, buta no kaku ni, maguro daikon, Japanese chicken curry, saba shioyaki, miso-marinated pork and a Wagyu-style burger.

details.intro: Hot Japanese dishes and grilled specialties prepared fresh on site.
details.secondary: All hot dishes are served with rice. Allergens: wheat, soy, crustaceans, fish.

items.name: Wagyu style burger

items.title: Japanese tea
items.text: Three tea stations offering a wide selection of Japanese teas – from sencha and gyokuro to oolong, wakocha and white tea.

details.intro: At three separate tea stations, Japanese teas will be prepared by Martin Kindl, Jiří Houska and Tomáš Pelich – experienced tea enthusiasts.
details.secondary: Visitors will be able to compare different processing methods, flavours and styles of Japanese tea preparation throughout the day.

items.name: Sencha
items.description: Japanese green tea that is steamed and shaped into fine needles.

items.name: Kamairicha
items.description: Japanese green tea processed by pan-firing.

items.name: Gyokuro
items.description: Japanese green tea known for being shaded before harvest.

items.name: Oolong
items.description: Tea made from partially oxidised leaves.

items.name: Wakocha
items.description: Japanese black tea.

items.name: Kurocha
items.description: Japanese fermented tea.

items.name: Hōjicha
items.description: Roasted Japanese green tea.

items.name: White tea / Hakucha / Shirocha

items.title: Saké
items.text: Five different sakes from Shizuoka, Kanagawa and Osaka, together with a selection of Japanese whisky.

details.intro: Nagomi Sake will offer a tasting of five different sakes from several regions of Japan. Visitors will be able to compare regional styles and the distinct character of individual producers.
